assumptions.statement: All submitted boundaries and key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry from the repository site package (provisional_boundaries.geojson), not official redlines. Areas and ratios are work values for recomputation only.
assumptions.impact: When official polygons arrive, site_boundary.geojson, key_areas.geojson, land_use.geojson and all derived metrics, figures, PDFs and HTML must be regenerated and updated.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage protection lines) must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use. No statutory control value is claimed.
assumptions.impact: floor_area_ratio, building_height_m, total_floor_area_sqm remain status=unknown; all height/massing statements are conceptual suggestions.

assumptions.statement: Existing-building footprints, age, structure, use and conservation status are not verified; buildings.geojson contains conceptual interface prototypes only and identifies no existing building.
assumptions.impact: No demolition/renovation conclusion is made; building_footprint_area_sqm is a design-layer work value, not an existing-conditions baseline.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, station boundaries, flows and parking supply are not verified. The west-side detour caused by Line 13 is acknowledged in an official public response but has not been measured on foot, and no cross-line bridge has been approved.
assumptions.impact: road_centerline_length_m is a conceptual work value. The access-gap map may mark the published problem and a field-audit route, but it cannot claim a measured detour, road alignment, bridge or tunnel solution.

assumptions.statement: The Beijing Municipal Cultural Heritage Bureau published the statutory protection scope and construction-control zone for the old Tsinghuayuan Railway Station in 2026. This package does not contain authority-issued survey coordinates or GIS polygons suitable for setting out works.
assumptions.impact: All nearby furniture, reading rails and service prototypes remain low, reversible and provisional. Their positions must be rechecked against formal coordinates before design development or construction.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, fire, energy and data infrastructure capacities are not available; municipal strategy is an interface checklist, not a capacity commitment.
assumptions.impact: No load, capacity or equipment-count calculations are made; GAP-MUNICIPAL marks the data gap.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition expresses conceptual functional tendencies of the OPEN BELT spatial grammar (TRUNK/COMMIT/PR), partitioned deterministically from the provisional boundary; it is not a statutory land-use plan.
assumptions.impact: Land-use codes follow the MNR classification guide for terminology only. All three R&D/prototyping units are encoded as 0802 (3,400,943.646 sqm); 0902 is absent from the allowed enum and submitted geometry and is therefore not_applicable.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual interface prototypes only; they do not identify existing buildings, ownership, floor counts or demolition/renovation conclusions.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm and building_footprint_ratio remain design-layer work values; building_density is unknown because conceptual prototypes cannot establish a statutory or planning density.

assumptions.statement: International cases are used for mechanism comparison only (open data, tiered testing, participatory governance, algorithm transparency, daily accessibility, negative governance lessons); no case is used as boundary authority or area basis.
assumptions.impact: Case references support mechanism design, not spatial facts.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios require opt-in participation, data minimization, staff review, an equivalent non-AI route and a clear stop condition. No scenario is claimed as deployed or approved.
assumptions.impact: The service desk, low-speed test court and scenario schedule are design suggestions, not existing administrative procedures.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day, one-year and three-year decision points are trial and review periods, not confirmed development timing, investment or approval.
assumptions.impact: phasing.geojson expresses conceptual sequencing only; no development schedule or investment commitment is made.

assumptions.statement: All renewal projects, annual events, brand assets and operation mechanisms are conceptual suggestions; none are confirmed government decisions, funded programs or approved arrangements.
assumptions.impact: No investment, timing or commitment claim is made.

assumptions.statement: The OpenStreetMap / Overpass extract may be incomplete or stale and is used only for contextual roads, paths, railways, stations, waterways, green spaces and POIs.
assumptions.impact: No OSM feature supports an official boundary, title, statutory control, as-built guarantee or precise-area calculation; critical intersections and facilities require field and official verification.

assumptions.statement: Official articles distinguish existing, approved, planned and operator-reported information; published plans are not treated as completed works.
assumptions.impact: The Qinghua East Road south-side project and Xiaoyuehe works are coordination interfaces, not proposal-authored projects or as-built claims; metrics with different scopes are never combined.

assumptions.statement: The Qinghuayuan Station photograph is a cropped CC BY-SA 4.0 Wikimedia Commons image by N509FZ and is used only as existing-heritage context.
assumptions.impact: The image supports no spatial control, design authorship, official endorsement or current-condition survey conclusion; the cropped derivative remains CC BY-SA 4.0.

assumptions.statement: The 80-percent shaded-road figure is a comparison value from Beijing guidance for green-isolation-area parks, not a verified existing or mandatory Jingzhang condition. Existing tree species, crown dimensions, health and summer shade have not been surveyed.
assumptions.impact: Any shade percentage shown in concept diagrams must be labelled as a simulation. A July clear-day model and a 14:00 field-photo check are required before setting a design target or claiming improvement.

assumptions.statement: Public-toilet opening hours, 250-metre walking coverage, drinking points, seat locations, backrests, armrests and wheelchair spaces have not been audited along the full corridor.
assumptions.impact: GB 51192 and Beijing guidance values are used only to prepare the survey sheet. New toilets, seat counts and wheelchair-space quantities cannot be fixed until existing facilities and accessible routes are checked on site.
